interface.name: arctic_shell_v1
interface.description: Offered by dwm.exe. A client only says which Win32 window a surface shows. Where windows are, which are visible and how they are stacked, dwm.exe reads from wineserver itself, never from the client.

arg.name: hwnd
arg.summary: window handle, as wineserver knows it

request.name: set_cursor

description.summary: the pointer over this client's windows

request.description: Sent by the process whose window is under the pointer when its cursor changes (WM_WINE_SETCURSOR). dwm.exe draws the standard arrow itself at the monitor's scale; any other cursor comes as its image, premultiplied ARGB, which dwm.exe copies at once. No buffer and no arrow: the cursor is hidden.

description.summary: a surface that shows a Win32 window
